translated_title: Sheinbaum Meets Privately with Maru Campos on Her Arrival in Ciudad Juárez
original_title: Sheinbaum se reúne en privado con Maru Campos a su llegada a Ciudad Juárez
author: Jesús Estrada
meta_description: At a private meeting in the Ciudad Juárez airport, Sheinbaum and Chihuahua's PAN governor Maru Campos discussed the case of CIA agents in an anti-drug operation and agreed that action must follow if any law was broken.
